mapper.select: SELECT MIN(B.CDATE) FROM VAL_VW_MST_HOLIDAY B WHERE B.IS_HOLIDAY = 0 and B.CDATE > #{nowday, jdbcType=DATE} and B.TRADE_CALENDAR_ID = #{calendarId, jdbcType=DATE}

select
from TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD where TOTLE_TRADE_ID = (select TOTLE_TRADE_ID from trd_product_deal where trade_id = #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.delete: delete from SETTLE_TRANS_TG_MAPPING T WHERE T.TRADE_ID_TG = #{tradeId}
mapper.select: select DISTINCT A.SEQ_ID from SETTLE_TRANS_DATA_TOTAL A INNER JOIN SETTLE_TRANS_DATA B ON B.APPLY_TRADE_ID = A.APPLY_TRADE_ID AND B.DEAL_DATE = A.DEAL_DATE AND B.SEAT_NUMBER = A.SEAT_NUMBER INNER JOIN SETTLE_TRANS_TG_MAPPING C ON C.TRADE_ID = B.TRADE_ID WHERE C.TRADE_ID_TG = #{tradeId}

SELECT DISTINCT ENTRUST_ID from (SELECT A.ENTRUST_ID FROM ETR_ENTRUST A INNER JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD B ON A.ENTRUST_ID = B.ENTRUST_ID WHERE B.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} UNION ALL SELECT A1.ENTRUST_ID FROM ETR_ENTRUST A1 INNER JOIN TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD B1 ON A1.ENTRUST_ID = B1.ENTRUST_ID WHERE B1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId})
